resources.string: Save logs for a bug report
Saves the system logs from now and from the last start, crash reports and a description of this r1 as one .zip in Download/haretic-reports. Takes about a minute.
What were you doing, and what happened?
The report stopped before it was done.
The file could not be written. Is the storage full?
The last start ended with a kernel panic. Its log is kept and goes into the report.
The last start ended with a kernel panic, but its log wasn\'t kept.
The last start ended with a watchdog reset. Its log is kept and goes into the report.
The last start ended with a watchdog reset, but its log wasn\'t kept.
Kept, they go into the report.
None. They are only kept when the r1 restarts, not when it was switched off or the battery ran empty.
Not looked at yet, the r1 is still starting.

The report lists your apps. Wi-Fi network names, accounts, phone numbers, IMEI and serial numbers are taken out, but the logs can still name Bluetooth devices nearby. Have a look before you post it in public.
